text.ms:
1. (1)  Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan
Perihal Dag angan (Larangan Penggunaan Pernyataan, Ungkapan a tau Petunjuk )
(Keluaran Kelapa Sawit dan Barang-Barang Minyak Sawit) 2022.

(2)  Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 15 Mac 2022.

Larangan

2.  (1)  Tiada seseorang pun boleh, dalam perjalanan perdagangan atau
perniagaannya, atau dalam apa -apa pengiklanan, menggunakan apa-apa pern yataan,
ungkapan atau petunjuk—

(a) yang mungkin mendiskriminasikan atau memboikot apa -apa
keluaran kelapa sawit atau barang-barang minyak sawit; atau

(b) yang tidak menggalakkan, melarang, menghalang atau
mempengaruhi mana -mana orang daripada menggunakan atau
mengambil apa -apa keluaran kelapa sawit atau barang -barang
minyak sawit.

 (2) Bagi maksud subperaturan (1)—

(a) "apa-apa pernyataan, ungkapan atau petunjuk" termasuklah
pernyataan, ungkapan atau petunjuk sebagaimana yang dinyatakan
dalam Jadual;

(b) "ungkapan" termasuklah representasi atau perbuatan; dan

(c) "keluaran kelapa sawit" dan "minyak sawit" mempunyai erti yang
diberikan kepadanya di bawah Akt a Lembaga Minyak Sawit
Malaysia 1998 [Akta 582].

 (3)  Mana-mana orang yang melanggar subperaturan (1) melakukan suatu
kesalahan dan boleh, apabila disabitkan , didenda tidak melebihi dua ratus lima puluh
ribu ringgit atau dipenjarakan selama tempoh tidak melebihi lima tahun.

JADUAL
[Subperaturan 2(1)]

PERNYATAAN, UNGKAPAN ATAU PETUNJUK

1. "Tidak mengandungi minyak kelapa sawit"

2. "Bebas minyak kelapa sawit"

Dibuat 11 Mac 2022
[KPDNKK. 600-1/1/18 Jld.2; PN(PU2)120/IX]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI
Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri dan Hal Ehwal Pengguna

TRADE DESCRIPTIONS ACT 2011

TRADE DESCRIPTIONS (PROHIBITION OF USE OF STATEMENT, EXPRESSION OR
INDICATION) (OIL PALM PRODUCT AND PALM OIL GOODS) REGULATIONS 2022

IN exercise of  the powers conferred by section 69
of the Trade Descriptions Act 2011 [ Act 730 ], the Minister makes the
following regulations:

Citation and commencement
1.  (1) These regulations may be cited as the Trade Descriptions
(Prohibition of Use of Statement, Expression or Indication) (Oil Palm Product and
Palm Oil Goods) Regulations 2022.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 15 March 2022.

Prohibition
2.  (1)  No p erson shall, in the course of any trade or business,  or in any
advertisement, use any statement, expression or indication—

(a) which is likely to discriminate  or boycott any oil palm product or
palm oil goods; or

(b) which discourages, forbids, hinders or influences any person from
using or consuming any oil palm product or palm oil goods.

 (2)  For the purposes of subregulation (1)—

(a) "any statement, expression or indication" includes the statement,
expression or indication as specified in the Schedule;

(b) "expression" includes representation or conduct; and

(c) "oil palm product" and "palm oil" have the meaning assigned to
them under the Malaysian Palm Oil Board Act 1998 [Act 582].

(3) Any person who contravenes subregulation (1)  commits an offence and
shall, on conviction, be liable to a fine not exceeding two hundred and fifty thousand
ringgit or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding five years.

SCHEDULE
[Subregulation 2(1)]

STATEMENT, EXPRESSION OR INDICATION

1.  "Does not contain palm oil"

2.  "Free from palm oil"

Made 11 March 2022
[KPDNKK.600-1/1/18 Jld.2; PN(PU2)120/IX]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI
Minister of Domestic Trade and Consumer Affairs
